subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: Which sentence means “Junk food is bad for your health”?
options: La comida basura es mala para la salud
La comida basura es buena para la salud
La comida sana es mala para la salud
La comida basura está mala para la salud
questions.explain: “La comida basura” = junk food and “mala para la salud” = bad for your health.

questions.q: What does “los pulmones” mean?
questions.explain: “Los pulmones” means “the lungs”.

questions.q: How do you say “You should drink plenty of water”?
questions.explain: “Se debe” = “one should” and “beber” (not “comer”) is used for drinks: “Se debe beber mucha agua”.

questions.q: What does “es comprensivo” mean?
questions.explain: “Comprensivo” means “understanding”, not “comprehensive”.

questions.q: What is celebrated at “las Fallas” in Valencia?
options: Huge sculptures are built and then burnt
questions.explain: At “las Fallas” giant papier-mâché figures (“ninots”) are displayed and then burnt in March.

questions.q: What does “engordar” mean?
questions.explain: “Engordar” means “to put on weight / get fat”; the opposite is “adelgazar”.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to keep fit'?
options: Hago ejercicio porque estoy en forma
Hace ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
Hago ejercicio para mantenerme en forma
questions.explain: 'Mantenerse en forma' = 'to keep fit' and 'para' = 'in order to'; 'hago' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The whole family gets together to have dinner”?
options: Toda la familia se reúne para comer
Todo la familia se reúne para cenar
Toda la familia se reúne para cenar
Toda la familia se reúne para desayunar
questions.explain: “Reunirse” = to get together and “cenar” = to have dinner: “Toda la familia se reúne para cenar”.

questions.q: What does “quedar con mis amigos” mean?
options: To say goodbye to my friends
To stay home from my friends
To meet up with my friends
questions.explain: “Quedar con” means “to meet up / arrange to meet”, so “quedar con mis amigos” = “to meet up with my friends”.

questions.q: What does “hacer footing” mean?
questions.explain: “Hacer footing” is a borrowed term meaning “to go jogging/running”.

questions.q: How do you say “I prefer subtitles to dubbing”?
options: Prefiero el doblaje a los subtítulos
Prefiero los subtítulos a la pantalla
questions.explain: “Los subtítulos” = subtitles and “el doblaje” = dubbing: “Prefiero los subtítulos al doblaje”.

questions.q: What does “mi medio hermano” mean?
questions.explain: “Medio hermano” means “half-brother” (one shared parent).

questions.q: What does 'el tabaquismo' mean?
questions.explain: 'El tabaquismo' is the habit/addiction of smoking, not a shop (that would be 'el estanco').

questions.q: What does “una entrada” mean (for a concert)?
questions.explain: “Una entrada” means a “ticket” for an event (it can also mean a starter or doorway).

questions.q: What is 'La Tomatina', held in Buñol?
options: A festival where people throw tomatoes
questions.explain: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish festival in which participants throw tomatoes at each other.

questions.q: What does “la Semana Santa” mean?
questions.explain: “La Semana Santa” literally “Holy Week” is the Easter celebration with processions.

questions.q: What does 'llevar una vida sana' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sano/a' means 'healthy', so 'llevar una vida sana' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: How do you say “I get on well with my sister”?
options: Me llevo bien con mi hermana
questions.explain: “Llevarse bien con” means “to get on well with”, so “me llevo bien con mi hermana”.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Social media can be dangerous'?
options: Las redes sociales pueden ser peligrosas
Las redes sociales pueden ser seguras
Las redes sociales son siempre divertidas
Los medios sociales puede ser peligroso
questions.explain: 'Las redes sociales' is feminine plural, so 'peligrosas' agrees; 'pueden ser peligrosas' = 'can be dangerous'.

questions.q: What does 'el bienestar' mean?
questions.explain: 'El bienestar' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: What does 'la Nochebuena' mean?
questions.explain: 'La Nochebuena' (24 December) means 'Christmas Eve'; 'la Nochevieja' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: What does “disfrazarse” mean?
questions.explain: “Disfrazarse” means “to dress up / wear a costume”, e.g. at carnival.
